title: 掩埋場最終覆蓋~Final landfill capping
focus: 將防滲、排水、沉陷與植生整合為掩埋場最終覆蓋證據~Integrate infiltration control, drainage, settlement and vegetation into landfill-cover evidence
summary: 本課以「將防滲、排水、沉陷與植生整合為掩埋場最終覆蓋證據」為主軸，依序處理覆蓋層功能分工、低滲透層完整性、差異沉陷與裂縫、植生含水與季節、巡查空間覆蓋。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Integrate infiltration control, drainage, settlement and vegetation into landfill-cover evidence, progressing through Roles of cover layers, Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Differential settlement and cracking, Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Inspection spatial coverage. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 覆蓋層功能分工~Roles of cover layers
units.mechanism: 將植生層、排水層與低滲透層分開，材料體積與壓實狀態要依各層記帳。 材料體積依堆積密度而變；粒子密度不可直接代替含孔隙的堆積密度。~Separate vegetation, drainage and low-permeability layers, accounting for volume and compaction by layer. Material volume depends on bulk density; particle density cannot replace density including pores.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：固體質量 m=6000 kg；假設堆積密度 rho=1500 kg/m³。公式 V=m/rho，計算得 4 m³。適用邊界：已知乾濕基與均勻堆積，未包含後續壓密與膨脹。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Solid mass m=6000 kg; assumed bulk density rho=1500 kg/m³. Formula V=m/rho gives 4 m³. Applicability: Known moisture basis and uniform packing; later consolidation and swelling are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「覆蓋層功能分工」，用已知容積箱和秤重核對密度，將鬆填、壓實與乾濕狀態分欄。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Roles of cover layers, Check density using a known-volume container and scale, separating loose, compacted, wet and dry conditions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把粒子密度當堆積密度會低估運輸或覆層需要體積。 在「覆蓋層功能分工」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using particle density as bulk density underestimates hauling or cover volume. Mark where this error can enter the Roles of cover layers flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 相同質量材料不論壓實狀態都占相同體積。~Equal material mass occupies the same volume regardless of compaction.
units.practice: 只將 rho 改成 1200 kg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 5 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only bulk density rho to 1200 kg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 5 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 降雨、蒸散與滲漏~Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage
units.mechanism: 蒸散型與低滲透型覆蓋的主導機制不同，水量比較需保留儲水項。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。~Evapotranspirative and low-permeability covers rely on different mechanisms; retain storage in water comparisons. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
units.verify: 針對「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 沒有立即排水就代表所有降雨永遠不會下滲。~No immediate drainage means none of the rainfall will ever percolate.
units.practice: 只將 P 改成 0.10 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 200 變成 400 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only P to 0.10 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 200 to 400 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 低滲透層完整性~Integrity of the low-permeability layer
units.mechanism: 干濕循環和裂縫可能破壞連續性，試體低滲透性不能代替覆蓋後的監測。 Darcy 定律將水力梯度與材料傳導係數連結到平均滲流；薄膜缺陷流不由這條均質式代表。~Wetting-drying cycles and cracks can disrupt continuity; low specimen permeability does not replace post-installation monitoring. Darcy law links gradient and hydraulic conductivity to mean seepage; geomembrane defect flow is not represented by this homogeneous relation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水力傳導係數 K=1e-9 m/s；梯度 i=2；面積 A=1000 m²。公式 Q=K*i*A*86400，計算得 0.1728 m³/d。適用邊界：飽和、層流、均質材料；不含接縫孔洞、裂縫或非飽和行為。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hydraulic conductivity K=1e-9 m/s; gradient i=2; area A=1000 m². Formula Q=K*i*A*86400 gives 0.1728 m³/d. Applicability: Saturated laminar flow in homogeneous material; seams, holes, cracks and unsaturated effects are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「低滲透層完整性」，核對試體飽和度、尺寸與水頭，再比較現場密實度及施工品質證據。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Verify saturation, dimensions and head before comparing field density and construction quality records. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 試驗室低 K 不會排除現場接縫或穿刺形成的洩漏。 在「低滲透層完整性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Low laboratory K does not rule out leakage through field seams or punctures. Mark where this error can enter the Integrity of the low-permeability layer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要材料 K 很低，任何施工缺陷都不會造成滲漏。~Very low material K prevents leakage regardless of construction defects.
units.practice: 只將 K 改成 2e-9 m/s，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.1728 變成 0.3456 m³/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only K to 2e-9 m/s, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.1728 to 0.3456 m³/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 表面排水坡度~Surface-drainage grade
units.mechanism: 保持坡向與排水出口通暢，局部積水會增加入滲並影響植生。 坡度影響重力排水方向；沉陷可改變原有坡向並產生積水。~Maintain grades and clear outlets; local ponding increases infiltration and affects vegetation. Slope controls gravity-drainage direction; settlement can reverse grades and create ponding.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：落差 Δz=1.5 m；水平長度 L=50 m。公式 slope=dz/L*100，計算得 3 %。適用邊界：幾何坡度計算，不推定滑動穩定或排水容量。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Elevation drop Δz=1.5 m; horizontal run L=50 m. Formula slope=dz/L*100 gives 3 %. Applicability: Geometric slope only; slope stability and drainage capacity are not determined.
units.verify: 針對「表面排水坡度」，用固定基準點重測縱橫斷面，找出局部反坡而非只量兩端。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Surface-drainage grade, Resurvey longitudinal and transverse sections against stable benchmarks to detect local reverse grades. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 端點高差正確仍可能在中間存在窪地。 在「表面排水坡度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correct endpoint elevations can still conceal a depression between them. Mark where this error can enter the Surface-drainage grade flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 兩端坡度合格即可證明全段沒有積水區。~Acceptable endpoint slope proves there are no ponding zones along the route.
units.practice: 只將 Δz 改成 1.0 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 2 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δz to 1.0 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 2 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 差異沉陷與裂縫~Differential settlement and cracking
units.mechanism: 廢棄物壓縮與分解造成不均沉陷，覆蓋系統應以時間序列檢查局部梯度。 差異沉陷相對距離給角變形尺度；平均沉陷不能描述接縫及排水層局部拉伸。~Waste compression and decomposition cause uneven settlement; inspect local gradients over time. Differential settlement over spacing gives an angular-distortion scale; mean settlement misses local stretching of seams and drainage layers.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：原覆層厚度 H=1.2 m；假想差異沉陷 Δs=0.08 m；水平距離 L=8 m。公式 distortion=ds/L，計算得 0.01 m/m。適用邊界：小變形幾何指標，H 只作剖面背景；不代替膜材應變分析。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Original cover thickness H=1.2 m; hypothetical differential settlement Δs=0.08 m; spacing L=8 m. Formula distortion=ds/L gives 0.01 m/m. Applicability: A small-deformation geometric indicator; H is section context only, not a membrane strain analysis.
units.verify: 針對「差異沉陷與裂縫」，沿穩定基準重測沉陷網格，對照裂縫、積水和植生變化。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Differential settlement and cracking, Resurvey a settlement grid from stable benchmarks and compare cracks, ponding and vegetation changes. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 整體平均沉陷小，局部梯度仍可能導致破壞。 在「差異沉陷與裂縫」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A small mean settlement can coexist with damaging local gradients. Mark where this error can enter the Differential settlement and cracking flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 平均沉陷很小就可忽略所有差異沉陷。~A small average settlement makes all differential settlement negligible.
units.practice: 只將 Δs 改成 0.12 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.01 變成 0.015 m/m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δs to 0.12 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.01 to 0.015 m/m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 膜材與接縫受力~Membrane and seam loading
units.mechanism: 沉陷和溫度作用會拉扯膜與接縫，試驗需辨識破壞位置而不只報最大力。 名目拉應力由拉力除原始截面積；膜材與接縫失效還受剝離、蠕變及缺口影響。~Settlement and temperature load membranes and seams; testing must identify failure location as well as peak force. Nominal tensile stress is force over original area; membrane and seam failure also depend on peel, creep and notches.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：拉力 F=500 N；試條寬 w=0.025 m；厚度 t=0.002 m。公式 stress=F/(w*t)/1e6，計算得 10 MPa。適用邊界：均勻單軸名目應力，不是材料允許應力或接縫驗收標準。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Tensile force F=500 N; strip width w=0.025 m; thickness t=0.002 m. Formula stress=F/(w*t)/1e6 gives 10 MPa. Applicability: Uniform uniaxial nominal stress, not allowable stress or a seam acceptance criterion.
units.verify: 針對「膜材與接縫受力」，記錄試片尺寸、載入速率與破壞位置，區分母材、焊縫和夾具滑移。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Membrane and seam loading, Record specimen size, loading rate and failure location, distinguishing parent sheet, weld and grip slip. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報最大拉力而不報尺寸，無法公平比較不同試片。 在「膜材與接縫受力」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Maximum force without specimen dimensions cannot compare samples fairly. Mark where this error can enter the Membrane and seam loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 拉斷力相同就表示不同寬度厚度的膜材強度完全相同。~Equal breaking force implies equal material strength for different strip dimensions.
units.practice: 只將 F 改成 600 N，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變成 12 MPa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only F to 600 N, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 10 to 12 MPa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 植生含水與季節~Vegetation moisture and seasonality
units.mechanism: 表土太乾影響植生，過濕影響根系通氣；季節監測需記錄層位與含水基準。 水和乾固體分別守恆；濕基含水率以總濕重作分母，乾固體重量才能跨不同含水狀態比較。~Dry cover soil stresses plants while saturation restricts root aeration; retain layer and moisture basis in seasonal monitoring. Track water and dry solids separately; wet-basis moisture uses total wet mass as denominator and dry mass permits comparison across moisture states.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕樣總重 mw=1000 kg；濕基含水率 w=0.30。公式 md=mw*(1-w)，計算得 700 kg dry solids。適用邊界：批次代表性樣本，乾燥減重視為水；揮發性物質或結晶水可能使此假設失效。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet sample mass mw=1000 kg; wet-basis moisture w=0.30. Formula md=mw*(1-w) gives 700 kg dry solids. Applicability: A representative batch sample with drying loss treated as water; volatile matter or bound water may invalidate the assumption.
units.verify: 針對「植生含水與季節」，保存稱重、乾燥方法及分樣紀錄，對比重複樣並檢查非水揮發損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Retain weighing, drying method and subsampling records and compare duplicates while checking non-water volatile loss. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 用濕重比較處理前後會把脫水誤認為固體去除。 在「植生含水與季節」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Comparing wet masses can mistake dewatering for solids removal. Mark where this error can enter the Vegetation moisture and seasonality flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕樣減重多少就代表固體或污染物被去除多少。~Wet-mass reduction equals the mass of solids or contaminants removed.
units.practice: 只將濕基含水率 w 改成 0.40，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 700 變成 600 kg dry solids。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only wet-basis moisture w to 0.40, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 700 to 600 kg dry solids. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 覆土甲烷氧化邊界~Cover methane-oxidation boundary
units.mechanism: 氧化只能作用於到達含氧反應區的甲烷，不能用單一假定率抹去所有排放。 收集、覆土氧化與逸散分屬不同通量；氧化率應作用於剩餘通量而非總量重複扣除。~Oxidation acts only on methane reaching an oxygenated zone; one assumed rate cannot erase all emissions. Collection, cover oxidation and escape are separate fluxes; oxidation acts on the remaining flux rather than being subtracted twice.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：生成甲烷 G=100 m³/h；假設收集率 c=0.70；氧化率 o=0.10（僅作用於未收集部分）。公式 escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o)，計算得 27 m³ CH₄/h。適用邊界：假想均勻平均率，不代表掩埋場實測或法定排放係數。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Generated methane G=100 m³/h; assumed collection c=0.70; oxidation o=0.10 applied only to uncollected gas. Formula escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o) gives 27 m³ CH₄/h. Applicability: Hypothetical uniform mean rates, not field observations or regulatory emission factors.
units.verify: 針對「覆土甲烷氧化邊界」，把收集流量、表面通量與氣體組成併看，保留不可量測項的不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Cover methane-oxidation boundary, Combine collected flow, surface flux and gas composition while retaining uncertainty in unmeasured terms. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只從抽氣量反推生成量會把假定收集效率當成觀測。 在「覆土甲烷氧化邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Inferring generation from collected gas alone turns an assumed efficiency into an apparent observation. Mark where this error can enter the Cover methane-oxidation boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 抽到的氣體量就是掩埋場產生的全部氣體量。~Collected gas equals all gas generated by the landfill.
units.practice: 只將 c 改成 0.80，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 27 變成 17 m³ CH₄/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only collection c to 0.80, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 27 to 17 m³ CH₄/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 巡查空間覆蓋~Inspection spatial coverage
units.mechanism: 將裂縫、侵蝕、植生缺口和積水圖層疊合，規則網格之外仍需追蹤異常。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Overlay cracks, erosion, vegetation gaps and ponding, following anomalies beyond the regular inspection grid. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
units.verify: 針對「巡查空間覆蓋」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Inspection spatial coverage, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「巡查空間覆蓋」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Inspection spatial coverage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。~A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.
units.practice: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 長期監測交接~Long-term monitoring handoff
units.mechanism: 覆蓋完成不等於後續無需管理，保存維修與監測缺口以支援跨年度判讀。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Cover installation does not end management; retain repair and monitoring-gap histories for multi-year interpretation. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「長期監測交接」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Long-term monitoring handoff, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「長期監測交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Long-term monitoring handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
